{{Quote|Two ships--most unfortunately---could not negotiate our tricky atmosphere, and crashed. So we built a space station and decided to use living pilots to ferry the raw spice material down to the factories.|[[Veratil]]|<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ylesian space station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] owned by the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] in the [[Cha Raaba system|Ylesian system]].<ref name="RD" />
